caption:
Real estate and property services businesses often deal with commission-based income that arrives in lumps rather than steady instalments, while overheads like staff and marketing continue regardless. A flexible facility can smooth these gaps.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs — understanding real estate and property services's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Commission-based income arrives in lumps, not a steady stream — a flexible facility helps smooth that pattern out.
